mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.real_name AS counselor_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id=c.id) AS student_count FROM lab_class c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id=c.counselor_id (c.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.major_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY c.grade_year DESC,c.class_name
SELECT u.id,u.username,u.real_name,u.phone,u.email FROM class_student cs JOIN `user` u ON u.id=cs.student_id WHERE cs.class_id=#{classId} ORDER BY u.username
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM class_student WHERE class_id=#{classId} AND student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*,u.real_name AS creator_name FROM experiment_project p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id=p.creator_id (p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_project WHERE id=#{id} AND creator_id=#{userId}

SELECT s.*,p.project_name,p.course_name,c.class_name,l.name AS lab_name,u.real_name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_attendance a WHERE a.schedule_id=s.id AND a.status='PRESENT') AS present_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_report r WHERE r.schedule_id=s.id) AS report_count FROM experiment_schedule s JOIN experiment_project p ON p.id=s.project_id JOIN lab_class c ON c.id=s.class_id JOIN lab_room l ON l.id=s.lab_id JOIN `user` u ON u.id=s.teacher_id
s.status=#{status} AND s.teacher_id=#{userId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM class_student cs WHERE cs.class_id=s.class_id AND cs.student_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY s.start_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_schedule WHERE id=#{id} AND teacher_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_schedule s JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id=s.class_id WHERE s.id=#{id} AND cs.student_id=#{userId} AND s.status<>3

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_schedule s JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id=s.class_id WHERE s.id=#{id} AND cs.student_id=#{userId} AND s.status<>3 AND NOW() BETWEEN DATE_SUB(s.start_time,INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(s.end_time,INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)

SELECT cs.student_id,u.username,u.real_name,a.status,a.check_in_time,a.remark FROM experiment_schedule s JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id=s.class_id JOIN `user` u ON u.id=cs.student_id LEFT JOIN experiment_attendance a ON a.schedule_id=s.id AND a.student_id=cs.student_id WHERE s.id=#{scheduleId} ORDER BY u.username
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experiment_report(schedule_id,student_id,title,content,attachment_url,status,submit_time) VALUES(#{scheduleId},#{studentId},#{title},#{content},#{attachmentUrl},1,NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title=VALUES(title),content=VALUES(content),attachment_url=VALUES(attachment_url),status=1,submit_time=NOW(),score=NULL,feedback=NULL,grader_id=NULL,grade_time=NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_report r JOIN experiment_schedule s ON s.id=r.schedule_id WHERE r.id=#{id} AND s.teacher_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_report WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status=2

SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_schedule s JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id=s.class_id WHERE cs.student_id=#{userId}) AS schedule_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_attendance WHERE student_id=#{userId} AND status='PRESENT') AS attendance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_report WHERE student_id=#{userId}) AS report_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(score),1) FROM experiment_report WHERE student_id=#{userId} AND score IS NOT NULL) AS average_score
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_schedule) AS schedule_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_attendance WHERE status='PRESENT') AS attendance_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiment_report) AS report_count, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(score),1) FROM experiment_report WHERE score IS NOT NULL) AS average_score
